proposals.proposedText: Jenny speaks softly and thoughtfully, often taking a beat before answering. Her humour lands quietly rather than as a big joke, and when she is embarrassed her words get smaller or more careful instead of dramatic.
proposals.groundedIn: Grounded in existing canon: “A thoughtful, sensitive schoolgirl with a quiet sense of humour.”
